scope: Synthetic acceptance example. This is not a new game, an approved physical adaptation, an actual studio roster or a schedule.

assumptionDefinitions.source: Recovered intake; physical-only is a hypothetical override.
Owner requested undo, quick color changes and layers; exact profile acceptance is still to be bounded.
Context/constraint only. No automatic scope pruning or finishability claim.

timeBasis.meaning: Hypothetical windows for comparing support. Capacity is not spread uniformly or allocated to tasks.

profiles.purpose: A bounded diagnostic pixel editing proof; no claim of production usability.
Owner-feedback production profile; exact operations and acceptance need definition.

qualities.acceptance: Recover the exact editable content after saving and reopening.
Undo a content edit and verify restoration; history depth and redo scope remain to be bounded.
Switch repeatedly among intended colors during editing without cumbersome re-entry; interaction acceptance remains to be bounded.
Preserve independently editable layers through save/reopen; exact layer operations and source format remain to be bounded.

needs.note: Shared source capability. Target-specific dimensions/format still require an explicit profile or adaptation.
An illustrative implementation need. Original A06 remains the TK3 GAM requirement.
No dimensions, print constraints, physical rules or approved whole-game adaptation are supplied.

members.reason: Required artwork must exist for this selected route; no game assets are supplied.
Artwork may be shared, while physical output constraints remain unverified.

people.provenance: Fictional role for acceptance; not an actual contributor.

validationCases: Unknown target remains unknown applicability; it is not treated as physical-only or hidden.
Every referenced assumption, need, profile, quality, tool, horizon and scenario must resolve.
An impossible or contradictory selected value combination is a validation error.
An applicable need with all routes excluded is reported with no applicable route.
A partly overlapping availability interval does not imply a prorated capacity.
Inherited scenario values must be fully expanded, cycle-checked and revision-pinned for an exported reproducible snapshot.
nextImplementation: Implement this contract with a bounded evaluator and existing director persistence/loading. These expected explanations are acceptance cases, not results computed by the current evaluator.

enablingWork.acceptance: Implement and verify each selected quality against the exact production profile before recording new support. External routes remain alternatives.
enablingWork.note: This is a technical enabling path, not permission to resume #146. Completing or assuming work does not automatically verify its tool outputs.
